This protects the early steps of the large SCALAR_LR and EMBEDDING_LR settings.","family":"schedule"},{"title":"Nonzero final learning-rate floor","spec":"Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.1 so that the warmdown ends at 10% of the peak learning rate instead of zero. All other schedule parameters remain the same.","family":"schedule"},{"title":"Linear decay of weight decay to zero","spec":"Scale WEIGHT_DECAY by a factor that decreases linearly from 1 at the start of training to 0 at the end, based on elapsed time fraction. Recompute the effective decay each step while keeping the base value 0.2.","family":"regularization"},{"title":"Value-embedding residual (ResFormer-style)","spec":"Compute value vectors in every attention layer and mix in the first layer's value vectors through a learnable per-layer scalar added to the current layer's values before attention. Initialize the mixing scalar to zero so the model starts identical to the baseline.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Logit soft-capping","spec":"Apply a soft cap to the output logits before the cross-entropy loss: logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15). Use the same scale for training and for the evaluation path as computed inside the model forward, without altering the evaluation call.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Deeper, narrower model","spec":"Change DEPTH from 8 to 10 and ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 48 so that model_dim = depth*aspect stays close to the baseline width while adding layers. Keep HEAD_DIM and all other settings unchanged, and check that the window pattern still matches the new depth.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Wider, shallower model","spec":"Change DEPTH from 8 to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 96 so the model is wider and shallower. Keep HEAD_DIM at 128 so the number of heads grows accordingly, and keep all other settings unchanged.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Full-context attention every other layer","spec":"Change WINDOW_PATTERN from 'SSSL' to 'SLSL' so that half of the layers use full attention and the others use the half-context sliding window. This tests whether more global attention helps the short-sequence regime.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Squared-ReLU MLP activation","spec":"Replace the MLP nonlinearity with relu(x)**2 in the feed-forward blocks, keeping hidden size and projections unchanged. This is a drop-in activation change with no added parameters.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Higher RoPE base frequency","spec":"Increase the rotary embedding base from 10000 to 100000 so that positional frequencies vary more slowly over the sequence. Keep head dimension and all other attention code unchanged.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Per-head learnable QK scale","spec":"After QK normalization, multiply queries and keys by a learnable per-head scalar initialized to 1, applied before the attention softmax. This allows each head to adapt its attention sharpness with negligible parameter cost.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Previous-token bigram mixing at input","spec":"After the token embedding, add a learnable gate-weighted contribution from the previous token's embedding (shifted by one position, zero-padded at the start). Initialize the gate to zero so training starts from the baseline embedding behavior.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Per-layer residual scalars with zero-init output projections","spec":"Make sure each block's attention and MLP output projection weights are zero-initialized and add a learnable per-layer residual scale initialized to 1, so every block starts as an identity mapping. Keep the existing per-layer scalars and their learning rate unchanged.","family":"architecture"},{"title":"Smaller total batch for more steps","spec":"Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 tokens per optimizer step, with gradient accumulation adjusted so DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE stays 64. This doubles the number of optimizer updates in the fixed time budget.","family":"batch"},{"title":"Larger total batch with same LR","spec":"Increase TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**20 tokens per step, adjusting gradient accumulation so DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE stays at 64. Keep all learning rates unchanged to test whether lower gradient noise helps within the budget.","family":"batch"},{"title":"Z-loss regularization on logits","spec":"Add an auxiliary z-loss term of 1e-4 times the squared log-sum-exp of the logits, averaged over tokens, to the training loss. This keeps logit magnitudes bounded and does not change the evaluation computation.","family":"regularization"},{"title":"Exponential moving average of weights","spec":"Maintain an EMA copy of the model parameters with decay 0.999 updated after each optimizer step, and copy the EMA weights into the model before the final training-state handoff to evaluation. The training forward and optimizer continue to use the live weights.","family":"other"},{"title":"Gradient clipping","spec":"Clip the global gradient norm to 1.0 before each optimizer step to guard against occasional spikes produced by the high Muon and scalar learning rates. Apply the clip to all trainable parameters.","family":"optimizer"},{"title":"Adam beta1 for scalars","spec":"Set the first Adam beta (beta1) for the scalar parameter group to 0.9 while keeping beta2 at 0.95, and leave the other Adam groups on ADAM_BETAS. This tests whether a smoother momentum helps the per-layer scalars.","family":"optimizer"},{"title":"Polar Express orthogonalization coefficients","spec":"Replace the fixed Newton-Schulz quintic coefficients inside Muon with the Polar Express per-iteration coefficient set for the same number of iterations. Keep the normalization and the learning-rate shape scaling unchanged.","family":"optimizer"},{"title":"Shape-aware Muon LR scaling","spec":"Scale the Muon update for each matrix by max(1, rows/cols)**0.5 so that tall matrices receive a proportionally larger step, and remove any other shape factor in the current update. Keep MATRIX_LR at 0.04.","family":"optimizer"},{"title":"Compile and throughput tuning","spec":"Enable fused or foreach implementations for the Adam and Muon steps and set torch.compile to mode='max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' for the training step only, with the evaluation path untouched. The aim is more tokens processed in the fixed 300 s without changing the math.","family":"other"},{"title":"Mixed-precision optimizer state","spec":"Keep Muon momentum buffers in bfloat16 instead of float32 to reduce memory traffic and allow a larger effective step rate. Cast to float32 only inside the orthogonalization step, leaving parameters in their current dtype.","family":"other"}]}

items.title: Muon momentum warmup
items.spec: Ramp the Muon momentum coefficient linearly from 0.85 at step 0 to 0.95 over the first 300 optimizer steps, then hold at 0.95. Implement by recomputing the momentum value each step from the step counter and writing it into the Muon param group before the optimizer step. Leave all other Muon settings unchanged.

items.title: Muon Newton-Schulz iterations 5 to 3
items.spec: Reduce the number of Newton-Schulz orthogonalization iterations inside the Muon update from 5 to 3. This trades a small amount of orthogonalization accuracy for more optimizer steps within the fixed 300 s budget. Keep the quintic coefficients and all learning rates unchanged.

items.title: Zero weight decay on embeddings
items.spec: Set weight decay to 0 for the token embedding and lm_head parameter groups (the Adam groups) while keeping WEIGHT_DECAY on the Muon matrix parameters. Only the param-group construction changes; the cautious masking logic is untouched.

items.title: Remove cautious masking from Muon weight decay
items.spec: Replace the cautious weight decay (applied only where the update sign agrees with the parameter sign) with plain decoupled weight decay p <- p - lr*WEIGHT_DECAY*p on all Muon matrix parameters. Keep WEIGHT_DECAY at 0.2 and the same LR schedule.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.95) so the Adam-optimized embedding, lm_head and scalar parameters use a longer first-moment memory. No other hyperparameters change.

items.title: Lower embedding LR, higher lm_head LR
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR to 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008. This rebalances the input and output Adam learning rates, since the current embedding LR is very large relative to the output head. All other settings remain the same.

items.title: Longer warmdown
items.spec: Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 so the LR decays over the final 70 percent of the time budget instead of the final half. Keep the warmup at 0 and the final LR fraction at 0.0.

items.title: Short linear warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 so every LR ramps linearly from 0 over the first 2 percent of the time budget before the existing warmdown begins. This is a trapezoidal warmup-stable-decay schedule, and nothing else changes.

items.title: Cosine warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown multiplier with a cosine decay from 1 to FINAL_LR_FRAC over the warmdown window, computed as 0.5*(1+cos(pi*progress)) where progress runs from 0 to 1 across the warmdown. Keep the existing time-based progress calculation.

items.title: Nonzero final LR floor
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.1 so the LR decays to 10 percent of its peak by the end of training rather than to zero. This keeps some update magnitude late in training. Keep the rest of the schedule unchanged.

items.title: ResFormer value residual
items.spec: Add a value residual: in every attention layer, mix the layer's value vectors with the first layer's value vectors using a learnable per-layer scalar lambda initialized to 0.5, so v = lambda*v_current + (1-lambda)*v_first. Apply it to all layers after the first. Keep the rest of the block unchanged.

items.title: Logit soft-capping
items.spec: Apply logit soft-capping before the cross-entropy: logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15). This bounds extreme logits and can stabilize the high-LR Adam-trained output head. Compute the capping in float32 and leave the loss function otherwise unchanged.

items.title: Deeper narrower model
items.spec: Change DEPTH from 8 to 10 and ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 52 so model_dim stays near 512 while the layer count rises. Verify that the head count still divides evenly with HEAD_DIM 128, adjusting the aspect ratio slightly if needed. Keep the other settings unchanged.

items.title: Squared ReLU MLP activation
items.spec: Replace the MLP nonlinearity with squared ReLU, computing relu(x)**2 in place of GELU or ReLU in the feed-forward block. Keep the hidden width and the projection layers the same. This is a single-line activation swap.

items.title: Rotary base 100000
items.spec: Change the RoPE base frequency from 10000 to 100000 for all attention layers. This changes the positional frequency spectrum over the context length. Nothing else in the attention block changes.

items.title: All-sliding-window with final full layer
items.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "SSSSSL" so there are more half-context sliding-window layers and only the last layer uses full attention. This is a cheaper attention pattern that may increase throughput. Keep all other settings unchanged.

items.title: Learned input skip into every block
items.spec: Keep a copy of the normalized token embedding x0 and, at the start of each transformer block, mix it into the residual stream as x = a_i*x + b_i*x0 with learnable per-layer scalars a_i initialized to 1 and b_i initialized to 0. Add these scalars to the scalar-parameter group. No other changes.

items.title: Grouped-query attention with 2 KV heads
items.spec: Use grouped-query attention with 2 key/value heads shared across the query heads, reducing the K and V projection sizes. Keep the number of query heads and the head dimension unchanged. This cuts parameter count and attention memory traffic.

items.title: QK-norm with learnable gain
items.spec: After RMS-normalizing queries and keys, multiply each by a learnable per-head scalar gain initialized to 1.0. Add these gains to the scalar-parameter group. This keeps attention logit scale adjustable without changing the head count.

items.title: Smaller total batch size
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 (about 262K tokens per step) so that the 300 s budget yields roughly twice as many optimizer steps. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE and all LRs unchanged, and make sure gradient accumulation still divides evenly.

items.title: Larger total batch size
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**20 (about 1M tokens per step) to reduce gradient noise at a cost in step count. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE at 64 and increase gradient accumulation steps accordingly. All learning rates stay the same.

items.title: Batch-size-scaled Muon LR
items.spec: Scale MATRIX_LR by sqrt(TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE / 2**19) relative to the baseline so the matrix-parameter LR tracks the effective batch size. Apply this only in the code that constructs the Muon param group, so the constant change is explicit and readable. Use this rule with the baseline batch size.

items.title: Z-loss regularizer on logits
items.spec: Add a z-loss term 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2) over the batch to the cross-entropy loss to keep the output normalizer from drifting. Compute it in float32 from the same logits used for the loss. Leave the reported loss value computed by the harness path unchanged.

items.title: Small label smoothing
items.spec: Apply label smoothing of 0.01 to the cross-entropy loss over the vocabulary. This softens targets and can slightly regularize a short-run model. Use the standard PyTorch cross_entropy label_smoothing argument and keep everything else unchanged.

items.title: Weight EMA for evaluation
items.spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of the model parameters with decay 0.999, updated after each optimizer step. Use the EMA weights for the final model state that gets saved and evaluated. Keep the training forward and backward passes on the live weights.

items.title: Short-to-long context curriculum
items.spec: In the training loop, use a shorter effective sequence length for the first 30 percent of the time budget by slicing each batch to the first half of the context, then switch to the full sequence length. Keep the data loader and batch shape contract unchanged, and only trim the input tensor before the forward pass.

items.title: Shuffle-stable data order
items.spec: Keep the same deterministic data order but iterate the training loader with a fixed shuffle buffer of the loader's own output, so consecutive batches come from less correlated positions. Implement only as a wrapper around the existing batch iterator and do not touch the file reading or prepare.py helpers.

items.title: Compile with max-autotune
items.spec: Change the torch.compile call to use mode="max-autotune" so kernels are tuned for the fixed shapes, trading longer startup compile time for faster steps. Verify the total startup plus training stays under the 450 s limit. Keep the model and training code otherwise unchanged.

items.title: TF32 and bf16 matmul precision
items.spec: Enable TF32 matmul and cuDNN TF32 at the top of train.py with torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True and torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = True, and keep bf16 autocast for the forward pass. This speeds up the fp32 parts such as the optimizer and loss without changing the model. Do not alter the seed lines.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup
items.spec: Ramp the Muon momentum coefficient linearly from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 300 optimizer steps, then hold at 0.95. Change only the momentum value fed to the Muon optimizer each step; leave learning rate, weight decay and Newton-Schulz settings unchanged.

items.title: Fewer Newton-Schulz iterations
items.spec: Reduce the number of Newton-Schulz orthogonalization iterations inside Muon from 5 to 3. This makes each optimizer step cheaper, so more steps fit into the fixed 300 s budget. Keep the quintic coefficients and everything else the same.

items.title: Shape-aware Muon update scale
items.spec: Scale each Muon update by sqrt(max(1, rows/cols)) so tall and wide matrices get comparable update magnitudes, which makes the MLP and attention projections share one learning rate sensibly. Apply this multiplier to the orthogonalized update before it is applied to the weight.

items.title: Per-row normalization after orthogonalization
items.spec: After the Newton-Schulz step in Muon, divide each output row by its RMS (with a small epsilon) and rescale to unit RMS, in the spirit of NorMuon. This equalizes per-neuron update sizes. Keep the rest of Muon unchanged.

items.title: Weight decay only on matrices
items.spec: Apply decoupled weight decay only to the 2D matrix parameters handled by Muon. Set weight decay to zero for the embedding, lm_head and per-layer scalar groups. Keep WEIGHT_DECAY=0.2 for the matrix group.

items.title: Adam epsilon and beta1 for scalars
items.spec: For the Adam groups (embedding, lm_head, scalars), change epsilon from the default to 1e-10 and set beta1 to 0.9 for the scalar group only, keeping ADAM_BETAS=(0.8,0.95) for the embedding and lm_head groups. Test whether the per-layer scalars need slower first-moment tracking.

items.title: Longer warmdown ratio
items.spec: Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 so the linear learning-rate decay covers the last 70 percent of the time budget instead of the last 50 percent. Keep warmup at zero and all peak learning rates unchanged.

items.title: Cosine warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine decay from the peak learning rate to FINAL_LR_FRAC over the last WARMDOWN_RATIO of the time budget. The multiplier is 0.5*(1+cos(pi*p)) where p is the fraction of warmdown elapsed. Keep the peak values unchanged.

items.title: Short Muon warmup
items.spec: Add a linear learning-rate warmup covering the first 2 percent of the time budget for the Muon matrix group only, starting from 10 percent of MATRIX_LR. Other groups keep their current schedule.

items.title: Nonzero final learning rate
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.1 so the learning rate decays to 10 percent of its initial value at the end of the time budget rather than to zero. Keep all other schedule settings unchanged.

items.title: Smaller total batch size
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 (about 262K tokens per optimizer step). This doubles the number of optimizer steps in the 300 s budget, trading gradient noise for more updates. Keep the learning rates and gradient accumulation logic unchanged, adjusting only the accumulation count implied by the batch size.

items.title: Batch-size ramp
items.spec: Start training with TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**17 and double it at 25 percent and 60 percent of the time budget up to 2**19. Recompute gradient accumulation steps whenever the batch size changes. Keep learning rates fixed across the ramp.

items.title: Z-loss on logits
items.spec: Add an auxiliary z-loss term 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2) to the training cross-entropy loss to keep output logits from drifting in scale. Compute it from the same logits used for the main loss and do not change the evaluation loss.

items.title: Logit softcap
items.spec: Apply a tanh soft cap to the output logits, logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15), before the cross-entropy loss in training. Use the same cap in the evaluation forward path only if it is already part of the model forward, so the harness path is not altered.

items.title: QK-norm with learned gain
items.spec: Apply RMSNorm to the query and key vectors of each attention head before RoPE, with a learnable per-head scalar gain initialized to 1. This stabilizes attention logits at higher learning rates. Keep head dimension and layer count unchanged.

items.title: ReLU-squared MLP width match
items.spec: Keep the MLP as ReLU squared but set its hidden expansion to 3x instead of 4x and use the parameter savings to add one attention head per layer, or leave head count and reduce the MLP only. The goal is to test whether attention capacity is more useful than MLP width at this scale.

items.title: Value residual from first layer
items.spec: Pass the value projection from the first transformer layer to every later layer and mix it into each layer's values with a learnable per-layer scalar initialized to 0.5. This is the ResFormer-style value residual. Keep all other parameters the same.

items.title: Token-shift mixing
items.spec: Before the first block, mix each token embedding with the embedding of the previous token using a learnable per-channel gate initialized to zero, so the model gets cheap bigram information. Keep the rest of the forward pass unchanged.

items.title: RoPE base increase
items.spec: Change the rotary embedding base from 10000 to 100000. This lowers the frequency of the slowest rotary dimensions and can help with the sliding-window and longer-context layers. Keep head dimension unchanged.

items.title: Deeper, narrower model
items.spec: Set DEPTH to 10 and ASPECT_RATIO to 52 so model_dim stays near 512 while adding two layers. Keep HEAD_DIM and all learning rates unchanged. This tests whether extra depth beats the current width-to-depth ratio under the fixed time budget.

items.title: Parallel attention and MLP
items.spec: Compute the attention and the MLP from the same normalized input in each block and add both outputs to the residual stream, GPT-J style, instead of applying them sequentially. This reduces the per-layer latency chain. Keep parameter counts unchanged.

items.title: Sliding window pattern change
items.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN from SSSL to SSSSSL so that only one layer in six uses full attention, reducing attention cost in the short-window layers. Keep all other settings unchanged and check that the final layer still uses full context.

items.title: Per-layer residual scalars
items.spec: Give each block two learnable scalars, one for the attention residual and one for the MLP residual, initialized to 1, and also a learnable scalar that mixes the initial token embedding x0 back into each block with initial weight 0.1. These replace fixed residual scaling with learned scaling.

items.title: Weight EMA for evaluation
items.spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of the model parameters with decay 0.999, updated after each optimizer step, and run the final validation on the EMA weights. The training weights are unchanged. This smooths the end-of-run iterate, which matters when the learning rate decays to near zero anyway.

items.title: Output projection zero init
items.spec: Initialize the output projection of the attention and MLP blocks to zero so each block starts as the identity and early training is stable at higher learning rates. Keep all other initializations unchanged.

items.title: Embedding init scale
items.spec: Initialize token embeddings from a normal distribution with std 1e-4 and the lm_head with std 0.02 scaled by 1/sqrt(model_dim). Small embeddings let the residual stream start near zero, which can improve early optimization with the high embedding learning rate.

items.title: Compile with max autotune
items.spec: Compile the model with torch.compile using mode max-autotune-no-cudagraphs, and use fused AdamW where Adam groups are used. These are speed-only changes that raise throughput inside the fixed 300 s budget without changing the math.

items.title: Use Adam for the scalar group with lower LR
items.spec: Reduce SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.1 for the per-layer scalar parameters only, since 0.5 is large for scalar gains and may cause instability. Keep EMBEDDING_LR, UNEMBEDDING_LR and MATRIX_LR unchanged.

items.title: Embedding learning rate sweep
items.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3 to check whether the current token embedding rate is overly aggressive. Keep UNEMBEDDING_LR, MATRIX_LR and SCALAR_LR unchanged so the effect is isolated to the embedding group.

items.title: Muon matrix learning rate sweep
items.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 and keep the warmdown schedule unchanged. Muon's orthogonalized updates have fixed norm, so a moderate increase may speed convergence in the short budget. Leave all other hyperparameters the same.

items.title: Lower weight decay for Muon
items.spec: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05 for the Muon matrix group. Less decay may help the model use its capacity within only a few thousand steps. Keep the Adam groups' settings unchanged.

items.title: Sequence length curriculum
items.spec: If the data loader can produce shorter sequences cheaply, train the first 30 percent of the time budget with half the context length and then switch to full context. Keep the number of tokens per optimizer step fixed by adjusting the per-device batch. This speeds early steps when attention cost dominates.

items.title: Validation-aligned data ordering
items.spec: Shuffle training sequences within each epoch with a fixed generator derived from the existing seed, and skip any document that repeats within the last 1000 sequences. Keep the harness seed lines untouched. This reduces repeated-context noise in the gradient across steps.

items.title: Lower total batch to 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep LR settings unchanged.

items.title: Lower total batch to 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accum becomes 1 or fewer; if tokens per micro-batch exceed total, use DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 to make it divide). Also scale MATRIX_LR to 0.03 for the noisier gradients.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep high LR for longer.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so that LR does not decay fully to zero.

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to give a short LR warmup, which may allow stable higher LRs.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay.

items.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero
items.spec: Make the Muon weight decay scale with the LR multiplier (or with progress: wd = WEIGHT_DECAY * (1 - progress)) so it fades toward the end of training.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 (down from 0.6) for token embeddings.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 for lm_head Adam.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 for per-layer scalars.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim = 384 at ASPECT_RATIO 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep width ~576, which is divisible by HEAD_DIM 128? use 4 heads of 144 only if valid, else ASPECT_RATIO 85 → dim rounded to multiple of 128). Smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO adjusted so model_dim stays a multiple of HEAD_DIM (e.g. ASPECT_RATIO 51 → 510 rounds to 512 if code rounds up). Test whether a deeper model pays off within 300 s; reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if memory is tight.

items.title: HEAD_DIM 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving twice as many attention heads; check that flash attention handles it and model_dim divides evenly.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL / shorter windows
items.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSL" (or "SSL") to test the speed vs quality tradeoff of sliding window attention; the last layer stays full.

items.title: All-short windows except last
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to test all-full attention, since short windows may cost quality; compare throughput loss.

items.title: ReLU^2 to SwiGLU MLP
items.spec: Replace the MLP activation with SwiGLU, with hidden size 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64 to keep parameter count equal (gate and up projections, then down projection). Initialize like existing MLP.

items.title: Logit softcap tuning
items.spec: Change the logit softcap value (likely 15) to 30, or if absent add softcap = 20*tanh(logits/20) before the loss. Keep the evaluation path untouched, just the model forward.

items.title: QK-norm scale and init tweak
items.spec: If attention applies RMS norm to q and k, multiply q by a learnable per-head scalar initialized to 1.2 (sharper attention). Add the scalar to the scalar-param Adam group.

items.title: Zero-init output projections
items.spec: Make sure attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights are zero-initialized (if not already), which stabilizes early training and allows a faster start.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter / 0.97 final
items.spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so it ramps from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps and final value 0.95 instead of 0.97 or whatever it currently is. Test a lower final momentum for the short run.

items.title: Muon Newton-Schulz steps 4
items.spec: Reduce the Muon polar-express / Newton-Schulz iterations to 4 steps (from 5) to save per-step time, if the code exposes the step count.

items.title: Gradient clipping at 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer.step to damp loss spikes.

items.title: torch.compile max-autotune off, bf16 fused extras
items.spec: Ensure the cross-entropy and optimizer steps are compiled; wrap the Adam step with fused=True if not set. This is a throughput change to raise tokens seen in 300 s.

items.title: Untied value-embedding drop on alternating layers
items.spec: If value embeddings are used on alternating layers, apply them on all layers or on only the last half, to test their cost/benefit tradeoff under the time budget.

items.title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown shape with a cosine decay over the warmdown fraction: mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) where t is progress through warmdown.

items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 so more optimizer steps happen in the fixed 300s budget. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accumulation halves). Leave other hyperparameters unchanged.

items.title: Total batch 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 with seq len gives accumulation of 1 or less; if total tokens per micro-step exceeds this, reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32). More steps for a short-budget run.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to retain a higher LR for longer.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so LR does not decay fully to zero.

items.title: Short warmup 3%
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to smooth early training, particularly with Muon and high Adam LRs.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.06
items.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 for faster learning in the short run.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Lower MATRIX_LR to 0.03 in case the current LR is too aggressive.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.9
items.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 to stabilize per-layer scalars.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1; short training probably needs less regularization.

items.title: Weight decay 0 for short run
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.0 to remove Muon cautious weight decay entirely, simplifying behavior.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-step
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep width at 576) so more tokens are processed in 300s. Ensure model_dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64 (dim 640, HEAD_DIM 128). Check memory; reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if needed.

items.title: Aspect ratio 80 at depth 8
items.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 (dim 640, 5 heads of 128) to make the model wider at the same depth.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so there are twice as many heads; may improve quality at the same compute.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL... all short except last
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" so only the final layer uses full context, cutting attention cost for more steps.

items.title: Window pattern all L
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" for full attention in all layers, testing whether quality outweighs speed.

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: If the model applies a logit softcap (e.g. 15), change it to 10; if none exists, add 15*tanh(x/15) to logits before the loss.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP expansion 3x
items.spec: Reduce MLP hidden dim from 4x to 3x model_dim for faster steps, trading capacity for throughput.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step to stabilize at higher learning rates.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter/higher
items.spec: Change the Muon momentum schedule so it ramps to 0.97 over the first 100 steps and then stays at 0.97 until warmdown, where it drops to 0.9. Edit only the schedule function.

items.title: Muon Newton-Schulz steps 4
items.spec: Reduce Muon orthogonalization iterations from 5 to 4 for a small speedup per step, if the code exposes ns_steps.

items.title: Cosine-shaped warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown in the LR multiplier function with a cosine decay: final-frac + (1-final-frac)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*progress_in_warmdown)).

items.title: Zero-init residual output projections
items.spec: Initialize attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights to zero if not already, so blocks start as identity and early training is stable.

items.title: Disable torch compile fullgraph overhead: use bf16 autocast check and fused Adam
items.spec: Ensure AdamW is constructed with fused=True and that no per-step host syncs occur (e.g. avoid .item() on loss every step; accumulate on GPU and read only every 10 steps), to gain throughput.

items.title: Smaller total batch 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so gradient accumulation halves). In a fixed 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Leave other hyperparameters unchanged.

items.title: Smaller total batch 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, making sure tokens per microbatch divides the total evenly. Gives many more steps in 300 s. Lower MATRIX_LR to 0.035 if unstable.

items.title: Depth 6
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 at ASPECT_RATIO 64; ensure dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM or let the existing rounding handle it). A smaller model sees more tokens in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO 64. If OOM, set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 while keeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE unchanged.

items.title: Aspect ratio 80
items.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 at DEPTH 8, giving a wider model (dim 640). Tests width versus depth under a fixed time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep the LR high for longer before decay.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.

items.title: Brief warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.02 to add a short LR warmup, which may stabilize early Muon steps.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for the Muon matrix parameters.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 for the Muon matrix parameters.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.9
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.9 for the token embedding Adam group.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 for the token embedding Adam group.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 for lm_head.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 for per-layer scalars; the current 0.5 may be too aggressive.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for cautious Muon weight decay.

items.title: Weight decay 0.3
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 for cautious Muon weight decay.

items.title: Weight decay linearly decayed
items.spec: Make Muon weight decay decay linearly to zero over training, multiplying WEIGHT_DECAY by (1 - progress) where progress is time fraction elapsed.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: All-short window pattern
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSS" with the final layer still forced to full context if the code does that. Cheaper attention gives more steps in 300 s.

items.title: Window pattern SSL
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SL" to use more full-attention layers and test whether context matters more than speed.

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: If the model uses a logit softcap (e.g. 15), reduce it to 10; if there is none, add softcap 15*tanh(logits/15) before the loss.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP ratio 3
items.spec: Reduce MLP hidden expansion from 4x to 3x (or keep it 4x if already 3x and raise to 5x), to trade parameters for step count.

items.title: Disable torch compile-unfriendly extras: bf16 value embeddings off
items.spec: If the model has value embeddings on alternating layers, restrict them to only the last 2 layers to save parameters and memory, and test whether the loss changes.

items.title: Muon momentum 0.97
items.spec: Increase Muon momentum from its current value (likely 0.95) to 0.97 at steady state, keeping any warmup of momentum.

items.title: Muon ns steps 4
items.spec: Reduce Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to speed up each step slightly, if the code exposes this parameter.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer.step to guard against spikes at higher learning rates.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so the model has twice as many heads; test whether more heads help at this size.

items.title: Total batch 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (no grad accumulation if seq len 2048 gives 131072 tokens). This tests many more, noisier steps. Consider lowering MATRIX_LR slightly if unstable.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over a longer final portion of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep the LR high longer before decaying.

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to add a brief linear LR warmup, which can stabilise early Muon/Adam steps at high LRs.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR doesn't decay entirely to zero.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 to check whether the embedding Adam LR is too high.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.9
items.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 to stabilise per-layer scalar parameters.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1. Short training may benefit from less regularisation.

items.title: Weight decay 0.3 with linear decay
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 and make it decay linearly to 0 over training, by multiplying by the LR schedule multiplier if it isn't already.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Depth 6
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 at aspect 64; consider ASPECT_RATIO 85 to keep width near 512). A smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10 narrower
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 so model_dim is about 512 (round to a multiple of HEAD_DIM), testing deeper models at similar width.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL variation
items.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSL" (more full-attention layers) and check the final layer is still L.

items.title: All short windows except last
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" (matches DEPTH 8) for cheaper attention and more steps; the last layer stays full.

items.title: Aspect ratio 80
items.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 for wider models (dim 640 at depth 8). Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE if memory requires, keeping total batch the same.

items.title: Aspect ratio 48
items.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 48 (dim 384 at depth 8), a smaller faster model with more steps.

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: If the forward pass uses logit softcapping (e.g. 15), reduce it to 10. If it uses none, add 15*tanh(logits/15) before the loss.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP ratio 3
items.spec: Change the MLP hidden expansion from 4x to 3x width (if ReLU² MLP is used) to cut compute per step and increase steps in 300 s.

items.title: Zero-init output projections
items.spec: Make sure the attention output projection and MLP output projection are zero-initialised, if not already. Otherwise skip the change and do nothing else.

items.title: QK norm scale tweak
items.spec: If QK-norm is used, multiply q by a learnable per-head scalar initialised to 1.2, or add one if absent. It sharpens attention in a short run.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer.step(). It helps stability at high LR.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter/higher
items.spec: Set final Muon momentum to 0.97 and reach it within the first 100 steps, instead of the current ramp, to test whether higher momentum helps.

items.title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown shape with a cosine shape: multiplier = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) over the warmdown portion, with t the progress through warmdown.

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: If the model applies a logit softcap (e.g. 15), reduce it to 10; otherwise add softcap 15*tanh(logits/15) before the loss in training only... only if consistent with the evaluation path; skip eval changes.

items.title: QK-norm scale tweak
items.spec: After RMS-normalising q and k, multiply by a constant 1.2 (sharper attention) before attention, applied consistently in all layers.

items.title: Zero-init residual projections
items.spec: Initialise attention output projection and MLP output projection weights to zero so each block starts as identity; keep other inits.

items.title: Muon momentum schedule
items.spec: Set Muon momentum to ramp 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 300 steps then hold, if not already; otherwise make the final momentum 0.97 during the warmdown.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step to reduce instability from the high LRs.

items.title: Disable torch compile overhead: fused/eager tweaks
items.spec: Keep compile but set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 with accumulation to lower memory and test whether throughput (tokens/sec) improves; keep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE unchanged.

items.title: Value embedding dropout-free: remove value embeddings on alternate layers
items.spec: If the model uses value embeddings on alternating layers, apply them to every layer instead (or if every layer, only to the last half) to test the parameter/speed trade-off.

items.title: Smaller total batch 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a 300 s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. No other change.

items.title: Total batch 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accum of 1 if seq len 2048 gives 131072 tokens per micro-step). Consider scaling MATRIX_LR by about 0.8 if unstable.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the final 70% of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to leave more time at peak LR.

items.title: Final LR frac 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not reach exactly zero.

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to ease the early Muon and Adam steps.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 for Muon.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.8
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.8 for token embeddings.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 for lm_head.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 for per-layer scalars.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay.

items.title: Weight decay linearly decayed
items.spec: Make Muon weight decay decay linearly to 0 over training, multiplying it by the current LR multiplier or by (1 - progress), instead of staying constant.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second moment estimates.

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and keep ASPECT_RATIO = 64 (or raise it to 96, keeping dim a multiple of HEAD_DIM). A smaller model gets more steps in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10. If memory is tight, lower DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32. This tests whether a larger model wins despite fewer steps.

items.title: Aspect ratio 80 at depth 8
items.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 with DEPTH = 8, so model_dim is 640 (a multiple of 128). Check that dim rounding stays correct.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL-free: all S plus final L
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" or equivalent so only the last layer uses full attention. This saves attention compute and gives more steps.

items.title: Window pattern all L
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to test full attention everywhere.

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: If the model uses logit softcapping (for example 15), change the cap to 10. If there is none, add a cap of 15*tanh(x/15) on the logits.

items.title: Disable torch compile recompiles / use bf16 autocast check
items.spec: Make sure the training loop avoids per-step CPU syncs such as .item() calls. Log the loss only every 50 steps. This gives a small throughput gain.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
items.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 to the first 150 steps, or raise the final momentum to 0.97. Edit the existing momentum schedule function.

items.title: Muon ns_steps 4
items.spec: Reduce the Newton-Schulz iterations in Muon from 5 to 4 to save compute per step, if the code has a configurable value.

items.title: Value embedding on fewer layers
items.spec: If value embeddings are on alternating layers, try dropping them from the layers that have them to cut parameters and embedding time. If there are none, skip this idea.

items.title: Init scale of output projections smaller
items.spec: Initialize the attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights at 0.5 times their current std, or to zero. This improves early training stability.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU
items.spec: Replace the MLP activation with SwiGLU with hidden dim about 8/3*dim, keeping the parameter count similar.

items.title: Label-free z-loss
items.spec: Add a small auxiliary loss 1e-4 * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2) during training only. Do not touch the evaluation path.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer.step() for stability at the higher LR.

items.title: Smaller total batch 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 so that more optimizer steps fit in the 300 s budget. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accumulation halves). No other changes.

items.title: Total batch 2**17 with lower LR scaling
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 gives 2 microbatch tokens worth, so accumulation steps become 1 if seq len 2048 gives 131072 tokens per 64 seqs; adjust so grad accumulation is an integer). Multiply MATRIX_LR by 0.8 to compensate for noise.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep high LR longer.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.

items.title: Short warmup 3%
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to smooth early training with the higher LRs.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.9
items.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 to stabilize per-layer scalars.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Lower WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1, since the short run has little need for regularization.

items.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero
items.spec: Make the Muon weight decay follow the LR schedule multiplier (wd = WEIGHT_DECAY * lr_multiplier) if it is not already, so that it vanishes at the end of training.

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99 for embeddings
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 at ASPECT_RATIO 64 would shrink; keep ASPECT_RATIO 96 so dim is 576, a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 rounding to 512 or 640 as the code does). Smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10 at aspect 56
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 and ASPECT_RATIO = 52 so model_dim ≈ 520 rounds to 512 (HEAD_DIM multiple). Deeper model with same width; check VRAM and reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if needed.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" -- fewer full-attention layers for speed (final layer is always full).

items.title: All-short windows except last
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SL" check effect of more full-attention layers versus throughput.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving more attention heads at the same width; check that flash attention path supports it.

items.title: ReLU^2 to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP expansion 3x
items.spec: Reduce MLP hidden dim from 4x to 3x model_dim to speed up steps and allow more tokens in 300 s; keep ReLU^2 activation.

items.title: Logit softcap 15
items.spec: Reduce the logit softcap value (currently likely 30) to 15 in the forward pass of the lm_head output, if a softcap exists; otherwise add 15*tanh(logits/15).

items.title: QK norm scaling gain
items.spec: After QK RMS-norm in attention, multiply q by a factor of 1.2 (fixed constant) to sharpen attention.

items.title: Zero-init residual projections
items.spec: Zero-initialize the attention output projection and MLP output projection weights in init_weights if not already, for a cleaner start.

items.title: Residual lambda init 0.9
items.spec: Initialize the per-layer residual scale scalars (resid_lambdas) to 0.9 rather than 1.0 and x0 lambdas to 0.2 rather than the current value.

items.title: Muon momentum warm to 0.97
items.spec: Change Muon momentum schedule to ramp to 0.97 (from the current final value, likely 0.95) over the first 300 steps, then keep it flat.

items.title: Muon ns_steps 4
items.spec: Reduce Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to save some per-step time.

items.title: Disable torch.compile-unfriendly gradient clipping / use grad clip 1.0
items.spec: Add gradient norm clipping at 1.0 before optimizer step to protect against spikes at higher learning rates.

items.title: Untied value embeddings on every layer
items.spec: If value embeddings are only on alternating layers, add them to all layers (same gating) to use more cheap parameters; watch VRAM.

items.title: Lower total batch to 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300 s budget, more optimizer steps usually helps a small model. Leave the other hyperparameters unchanged.

items.title: Batch 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (accumulation 1 if sequence length is 2048). Also scale MATRIX_LR by about 0.8 to stay stable at the smaller batch.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over a longer part of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to keep the LR high for longer, and compare with the baseline value of 0.5.

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to avoid early instability from Muon and the high embedding LR.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05, with the other settings unchanged.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 to test sensitivity of the embedding Adam LR.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalar parameters.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1. The run is short, so less regularization may help.

items.title: Weight decay decaying with LR schedule
items.spec: Make the Muon weight decay follow the LR multiplier, so wd_t = WEIGHT_DECAY * lr_mult. If it is already scheduled this way, instead use a linear decay to 0 over training.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Depth 6 wider-faster
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 96, so model_dim is 576 (rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM if needed). This gives a shallower model with more steps in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 52 so the width stays near 512. Check that this is a multiple of HEAD_DIM. Use DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 if memory is tight.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 to get more attention heads at the same width.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL-less: all short except last
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSS", so the final layer is forced full by the existing code, which is cheaper per step. Compare against the baseline.

items.title: Window pattern SL
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SL" to alternate short and long windows.

items.title: Smaller sliding window
items.spec: If the short window is half the context, change it to a quarter of the context (sequence_len // 4) for faster attention at little loss.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU
items.spec: Replace the MLP activation with SwiGLU, with hidden size about 8/3 * dim rounded to a multiple of 64, so the parameter count stays the same. Initialize the new gate projection like the up projection.

items.title: Logit softcap 15
items.spec: If the logits are soft-capped, lower the cap to 15. If there is no cap, add logits = 15 * tanh(logits / 15) before the loss.

items.title: Untied zero-init projections check / init scale
items.spec: Scale the init std of the attention and MLP input matrices by 0.8. Keep the output projections zero-initialized.

items.title: Disable torch.compile dynamic overhead: eval-free speedups
items.spec: Check that the training loop avoids per-step CPU syncs, e.g. calling .item() on the loss every step. Log the loss only every 10 steps, keep it as a tensor in between, and use fused Adam. This raises throughput and so the number of steps in 300 s.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
items.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp (0.85 to 0.95) from 300 steps to 100 steps, and set the final momentum to 0.97 during warmdown.

items.title: Muon NS steps 4
items.spec: Reduce the Newton-Schulz iterations in Muon from 5 to 4 to save time per step, if the code exposes this setting.

items.title: Value embedding on alternate layers
items.spec: If value embeddings are used on every layer, restrict them to alternating layers. This saves parameters and memory and may allow a larger batch.

items.title: Cosine-shaped warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: lr_mult = 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * progress_in_warmdown)), with the same WARMDOWN_RATIO and a floor at FINAL_LR_FRAC.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step, which stabilizes the high-LR Adam parameters.

items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.65 so the LR decays linearly over a longer final portion of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.35

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to smooth early Muon/Adam updates at high LR.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 for Muon parameters.

items.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9.

items.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR to 0.25 to stabilize per-layer scalars.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay.

items.title: Weight decay 0.3
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3.

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 with ASPECT_RATIO 64); smaller model gets more tokens in 300s. Consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep width (dim 576, adjust to a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128 → use 640 via ASPECT_RATIO 107 if required).

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10, DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 32 if memory requires; test whether larger model wins despite fewer steps.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving more attention heads; may improve quality at the same width.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL... all-short plus last long
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" is not needed; instead use "SL" alternation to test more full-attention layers versus speed.

items.title: Window pattern mostly short
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSSSSL" so only the last layer is full-context, trading context for speed.

items.title: Logit softcap tweak
items.spec: If the model uses a logit softcap (e.g. 15), change it to 30; if none exists, add 30*tanh(logits/30) before the loss in training only if the eval path is unaffected (apply inside the model forward consistently).

items.title: Squared ReLU to ReLU-squared with smaller MLP ratio
items.spec: Reduce MLP expansion from 4x to 3x and use the saved compute for speed (more steps). Keep activation unchanged.

items.title: Zero-init output projections
items.spec: Ensure attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights are zero-initialized (if not already), so residual blocks start as identity.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
items.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp (e.g. from 300 steps to 100 steps) and set final momentum to 0.97 if currently 0.95.

items.title: Muon NS steps 4
items.spec: Reduce Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to cut optimizer overhead if currently 5.

items.title: Disable torch compile overhead in eval-free loop: fewer GC pauses
items.spec: Call gc.collect() once after the first step then gc.disable() (if not already) to avoid Python GC stalls in the training loop, gaining a few more steps in 300s.

items.title: Value embedding LR separate
items.spec: If value embeddings exist, give them their own Adam group with LR 0.3 rather than sharing EMBEDDING_LR.

items.title: Small dropout-free token embedding noise
items.spec: Skip; instead apply embedding weight decay of 0.01 via Adam weight_decay on token embedding group for light regularization.

items.spec: Combined: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2**18, MATRIX_LR=0.035, WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.6.

items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step to stabilize at high LRs.

items.title: Halve total batch size
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, so grad accumulation drops to 2 steps wait: 2**18/(64*2048)=2). In a 300 s budget more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep all LRs unchanged.

items.title: Quarter total batch size
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (one micro-step per optimizer step with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and seq len 2048). Many more steps in 300 s. Optionally scale MATRIX_LR by 0.8 if unstable.

items.title: Shorter warmdown
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more of the budget is spent at peak LR.

items.title: Longer warmdown
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer linear decay to zero.

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to avoid early instability at high Muon/Adam LRs.

items.title: Nonzero final LR
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the end of training still makes progress rather than decaying fully to zero.

items.title: Higher matrix LR
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Lower matrix LR
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Lower weight decay
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for cautious Muon weight decay.

items.title: Higher weight decay
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 for cautious Muon weight decay.

items.title: Higher unembedding LR
items.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 for lm_head Adam.

items.title: Lower embedding LR
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 for token embeddings.

items.title: Lower scalar LR
items.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 for per-layer scalars, which may be too noisy at 0.5.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates.

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384 at ASPECT_RATIO 64, adjust so dim is a multiple of HEAD_DIM; use ASPECT_RATIO=86 giving ~516 rounded to 512). Smaller model gets more tokens in 300 s.

items.title: Depth 10 model
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 so model_dim is about 512 (multiple of 128). Tests deeper-narrower tradeoff; may be slower per step.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at same model dim; check flash attention supports it and n_kv_head follows n_head.

items.title: All-short-plus-last-long window
items.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSL"-style; with depth 8 use "SSSSSSSL" so only the last layer has full context, reducing attention cost and allowing more steps.

items.title: Window pattern all long
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to test whether full context everywhere beats the speed loss.

items.title: Smaller short window
items.spec: Where the short window size is computed as half the sequence length, change it to a quarter of the sequence length (512 for seq 2048).

items.title: Logit softcap tweak
items.spec: If the model applies a logit softcap (e.g. 15), change it to 30; if none exists, add softcap 30 via tanh on logits before the loss.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP ratio 3
items.spec: Reduce MLP hidden expansion from 4x to 3x and use the saved compute for speed (more steps). Keep activation unchanged.

items.title: Zero-init projections check
items.spec: Ensure the attention output projection and MLP output projection are zero-initialized (c_proj weights set to zeros) if not already; otherwise scale their init by 0.5.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
items.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum ramp (0.85 to 0.95) from its current duration to a third of it, or raise final momentum to 0.97 near the end of training.

items.title: Muon NS steps 4
items.spec: Reduce Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 if configurable, to save time per step.

items.title: Disable torch compile overhead: fused eval skip
items.spec: Reduce the frequency of any intermediate evaluation or logging sync (e.g. .item() calls every step) so that only every 10 steps is synced, increasing throughput inside the fixed time budget.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step to stabilize training with higher LRs.

items.title: Untied value-embedding LR scale
items.spec: If value embeddings exist, give them a lower LR (0.5x EMBEDDING_LR) in their own Adam param group; otherwise scale embedding LR by 1/sqrt(dim/768) as in muP-style tuning.

items.title: Time-based LR schedule sanity: cosine warmdown
items.spec: Replace the linear warmdown shape with a cosine decay: lr_mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1-FINAL_LR_FRAC)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) over the warmdown portion, t in [0,1].

items.title: Lower total batch to 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (~262K tokens/step). In a 300 s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves automatically.

items.title: Lower total batch to 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (2 microbatches of 64x2048 if seq 2048 gives 131K tokens per step, so accumulation 1). Check that the grad accumulation computation still divides evenly. Consider scaling MATRIX_LR by 0.85.

items.title: Shorter warmdown
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more time is spent at full LR.

items.title: Longer warmdown
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer decay phase.

items.title: Small warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to stabilize early Muon and Adam steps at high LR.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not decay fully to zero.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon, since short training needs less regularization.

items.title: Weight decay linearly decayed
items.spec: Make Muon weight decay scale with the LR schedule multiplier (or linearly decay to zero over training) if it is not already so; keep the base value at 0.2.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for per-layer scalars.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.8, 0.99).

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 with ASPECT_RATIO = 85 (dim ~512 rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM) so there is more throughput per step in the 300 s budget.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 so that model_dim stays about 512 to 640, rounded to HEAD_DIM multiples. Tests whether depth beats step count.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width.

items.title: Window pattern SSSSL-ish
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL" or "SL" variants. Try "SSL" to give more full-context layers. The last layer must remain L.

items.title: All-short window with quarter context
items.spec: Reduce the short window size from half to quarter context (seq_len//4) for S layers to speed up attention, keeping the last layer full.

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: If the model uses a logit softcap (e.g. 15), reduce it to 10. If there is none, add 15*tanh(logits/15) before the loss.

items.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite
items.spec: If the MLP uses relu^2, test replacing it with SwiGLU at hidden size 8/3*dim rounded to a multiple of 64, keeping the parameter count about the same.

items.title: Zero-init projections check
items.spec: Make sure the output projections of attention and the MLP are zero-initialized, and the lm_head is initialized with small std (0.001). Add this if absent.

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter
items.spec: Shorten the Muon momentum warmup ramp (0.85 to 0.95) to the first 100 steps, or raise the final momentum to 0.97 during the warmdown phase.

items.title: Muon NS steps 4
items.spec: Reduce the Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to save time per step, if the code exposes a ns_steps parameter.

items.title: Value embeddings on all layers
items.spec: Apply value embeddings (with gating) on every layer rather than alternating layers. Costs parameters but is often beneficial.

items.title: Remove value embeddings
items.spec: Ablate value embeddings entirely to reduce embedding-Adam load and speed up steps, if they are present.

items.title: Compile with max-autotune-no-cudagraphs
items.spec: Change the torch.compile mode to max-autotune-no-cudagraphs for faster kernels. Compile time is not counted, but startup plus training must stay under 450 s.

items.title: Gradient clipping 1.0
items.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step to stabilize at high LR.

items.title: Untie residual lambda init
items.spec: Initialize the per-layer residual scalar resid_lambdas to 1.0 and the x0 lambdas to 0.1, tuning them to resid 1.0 / x0 0.2 for faster early learning.

items.title: Smaller total batch 2**18
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model. Leave other hyperparameters unchanged.

items.title: Smaller total batch 2**17
items.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (grad accum of 1 if seq len 2048 gives 131072 tokens per micro-step). Consider lowering MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.03 for stability.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.7
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over a longer final portion of the time budget.

items.title: Warmdown ratio 0.3
items.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 to retain a longer high-LR phase.

items.title: Short warmup
items.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to reduce early instability from high Muon/Adam LRs.

items.title: Final LR fraction 0.05
items.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not hit exactly zero at the end.

items.title: Depth 6 wider-per-time
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 (model_dim 384*... via ASPECT_RATIO 64 gives 384; consider ASPECT_RATIO 96 to keep width 576, HEAD_DIM 128 divisibility required: 576/128 is not an integer so use ASPECT_RATIO 85->512 style value giving dim multiple of 128, e.g. ASPECT_RATIO 86 -> 516 rounds up per code). Fewer layers give more steps in 300s.

items.title: Depth 10
items.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 64 (dim 640, divisible by 128). Test whether a bigger model wins despite fewer steps; reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if OOM.

items.title: Head dim 64
items.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 so there are twice as many attention heads at the same width. Check that n_head/kv heads settings derive from HEAD_DIM.

items.title: Window pattern SSSS+final L
items.spec: Change WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSL" or equivalent with fewer full-attention layers (the last layer is always full), to speed up attention and gain more steps.

items.title: All-long window
items.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" to test whether full-context attention in every layer helps per-step quality enough to offset speed.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.05
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Matrix LR 0.03
items.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.03 for Muon parameters.

items.title: Embedding LR 0.4
items.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.4 (down from 0.6) for the token embedding Adam group.

items.title: Unembedding LR 0.008
items.spec: Set UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 to double the lm_head LR.

items.title: Scalar LR 0.25
items.spec: Set SCALAR_LR = 0.25 for the per-layer scalar parameters.

items.title: Weight decay 0.1
items.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious weight decay; short runs may need less regularization.

items.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero
items.spec: Make the Muon weight decay scale with the LR multiplier (or linearly decay to 0 over training) rather than staying constant, if it is not already.

items.title: Adam beta2 0.99
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.8, 0.99) for smoother second-moment estimates in embedding/scalar groups.

items.title: Adam beta1 0.9
items.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS = (0.9, 0.95).

items.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter/higher
items.spec: Change Muon momentum schedule to ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps, then hold 0.95 and drop to 0.9 during warmdown (modify the existing momentum function minimally).

items.title: Logit softcap lower
items.spec: Reduce the logit softcap value (e.g. from 15 to 10) in the forward pass, if a softcap exists; otherwise add 15*tanh(x/15) on logits.

items.title: ReLU^2 to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP expansion 3x
items.spec: Reduce MLP hidden size from 4x to 3x dim to speed up steps, and see if the throughput gain outweighs capacity loss.

items.title: Untied value-embedding removal
items.spec: If value embeddings are used on alternating layers, restrict them to only the last 3 layers to save params and time; otherwise skip this.

items.title: Disable torch compile recompiles / use max-autotune
items.spec: Pass mode='max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' to torch.compile on the model, ensuring compile time stays under the 450s limit; may increase throughput.

items.title: Fused AdamW and bf16 flags
items.spec: Ensure Adam groups use fused=True and enable torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 and cudnn tf32 to speed up non-bf16 ops.

items.title: Init scale of output projections
items.spec: Initialize attention c_proj and MLP c_proj to zero (or 0.5x current std) to improve early training.

items.title: QK-norm scale tweak
items.spec: Multiply queries/keys after RMS norm by a learnable or fixed scale of 1.2 to sharpen attention.

items.title: Rotary base 50000
items.spec: Increase rotary embedding base from 10000 to 50000 (or decrease to 5000) and check val effect.

items.title: Time-based LR progress with gradient clipping
items.spec: Add gradient clipping at max norm 1.0 on all parameters before optimizer step to reduce instabilities at high LR.
